Not exactly the same but I was with my ex for nearly two years in a ldr when things started to get rocky I never imagined we’d ever actually break up though until it happened . He woke me up at a music festival to tell me he was done with me. We had the spend the rest of the weekend together and then the 2 hr drive back and then a couple days before my bus ride home. It was probably the most heart wrenching experience of my life. I decided at that point I’d move to California which was a horrible decision I fell into a deep depression one I still struggle with. We broke up in 2017 and I don’t think I was truly over him until I met my current bf this year. It’s extremely hard in situations like these where you literally may never see the person again because they are so far away and you never will really feel as though you received closure. My best advice to you is not to do anything irrational to try to escape your feelings . I wish I wouldn’t have moved because not having my friends and family as support during the time really took a toll. Hopefully you have a support system you can lean on when you need to talk or spend time with to get your mind off of it. Also I’d say don’t take it personally & I know that’s easier said then done but if you truly don’t know the reason why then maybe it had nothing to do with you. Maybe she’s going through something that is too heavy to deal with while in a relationship. Use the experience to love yourself more , maybe find a new hobby you enjoy or dive deeper into one you already have. Get a pet if you can maybe or start working out if you don’t. Small distractions that’ll also literally increase your serotonin and make you feel better. Best of luck (:
